text:
Anya (Partner Eng): heads up — we’re seeing a perf regression in the quantized kernels when running on CUDA 12.2.0 + nvidia driver 535.xx on some marketplace images. partner reported ~30% token p99 increase.

Ethan M (Infra): ouch. do we have a repro? logs or job id?

Anya (Partner Eng): repro attached from partner (shortened):
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] model_infer: kv_cache_miss spikes, kernel launch latency +120us
[2026-03-18T14:12:04Z] quant_conv: fallback to generic kernel
[2026-03-18T14:12:04Z] WARNING: cudnn error code 9
```

Kai - Marketplace: cc @Ethan M @Sarah L — we pushed a base image with CUDA 12.2 last week. Partners starting to roll with it. can we pin the marketplace image to CUDA 12.1 until we triage? :thinking_face:

driver-checker-bot: nvidia-smi quick check:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader
535.54
```

Sarah L (QA): I can reproduce locally on our CI with the partner prompt set. Quick diffs show the quant kernels behave fine on driver 530.x + CUDA 12.1.

Ethan M (Infra): plan suggestion: 1) immediate mitigation: pin marketplace GPU images to CUDA 12.1 + driver 530.x; 2) run expanded regression matrix across our fleet; 3) open hotfix coordination with driver vendor if kernel bug confirmed.

Anya (Partner Eng): agree. @Kai can you hold the marketplace rollout and add a note to release page? We should avoid a public incident.

Kai - Marketplace: holding rollout now — setting a rollback flag and pausing auto-updates. will add a short advisory: "We recommend CUDA 12.1 for latency-sensitive workloads until further notice." :warning:

Ethan M (Infra): creating infra ticket and test matrix: infra/DRV-9827 (pin images, run matrix 530/535 x CUDA12.1/12.2 x quantized models). tagging @Sarah L for test ownership.

Sarah L (QA): taking test ownership. I'll run the matrix across small/medium/long sequences, and collect perf traces + nvprof snapshots. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Anya (Partner Eng): outreach plan to partner/vendor: 1) send minimal repro + perf traces; 2) ask vendor to validate kernel behavior (possible cuBLAS/cuDNN change); 3) request hotfix timeline or recommended driver pin. I'll draft and share.

Ethan M (Infra): if vendor confirms bug, we coordinate a hotfix + marketplace image update. backup plan: ship a transparently downgrading fallback in runtime that forces the older kernel path for quant ops (low-risk, but possible perf impact).

Anya (Partner Eng): for messaging: no joint announcement yet. keep communications narrow to impacted partners and internal GTM until we have root cause. legal/comms on standby.

Kai - Marketplace: noted. I'll add a short banner to the marketplace docs and an internal note in the partner onboarding doc to pin to 12.1.

driver-checker-bot: automated scan scheduled: 1899991400 — will report fleet-wide driver/CUDA combinations.

Sarah L (QA): quick ask — can someone paste the exact docker tags we should pin? makes the PR easier.

Ethan M (Infra): use: `redwood/gpu-runtime:cuda12.1-driver530-20260315` as the interim pinned tag. I'll update infra manifests.

Anya (Partner Eng): thanks all. I'll drop the partner outreach draft here when done and update the ticket infra/DRV-9827 with repro + traces. :thumbsup:

Kai - Marketplace: thanks. ping me if partner wants a back-ported image we can host internally for them.

Anya (Partner Eng): action items recap in thread:
- @Kai: hold rollout, add advisory + banner (done)
- @Ethan M: create infra ticket + pin images (infra/DRV-9827)
- @Sarah L: run regression matrix & upload traces (ETA EOD)
- @Anya: partner/vendor outreach + repro pack
- driver-checker-bot: fleet scan scheduled

Anya (Partner Eng): will follow up here with vendor response. thanks folks! :pray:
